Back alley brewpub
Nov 2022 • Couples
Great little spot in a back alley in Nha Trang. They have lots of great craft beer options - several of their local brews on tap which are cheaper, and a good collection of craft beers from other breweries in bottles that are slightly cheaper. 

A really good food menu too - enough here for my vegetarian partner and some great meat options for me too.

If you love craft beer and a nice vibe, check this place out!
